title: Understanding Recall
text: Recall is a measure of a model's ability to identify all relevant instances. It is calculated as the number of true positives divided by the sum of true positives and false negatives.

title: Comparing Models
text: To determine which model has the highest recall, compare the recall values of Model A, Model B, and Model C.

title: Recall Calculation for Model B
text: If Model B has $$80$$ true positives and $$20$$ false negatives, calculate its recall.

title: Final Decision
text: After calculating the recall for each model, choose the one with the highest value.
